sources.title: Claude Managed Agents session budgets
sources.supports: Budget checked between requests; in-flight requests complete; model overrun bounded by one request per thread.
sources.adaptation_limit: Dollars in Claude; known provider-reported tokens in Relay. Does not prove a bound on unknown usage or retry billing.

sources.title: Python 3.12 shielding from cancellation
sources.supports: Inner task may continue while the cancelled caller still raises CancelledError.

sources.title: Temporal Python workflow message passing
sources.supports: Use asyncio.Lock to serialize handlers accessing shared workflow state.
sources.adaptation_limit: Supports the synchronization pattern, not Relay snapshot versioning, database transactions or fencing.
